artifact_observations.reasoning: The three horizontal velvet bars (indicating doctoral status) appear slightly flattened and lack the distinct pile texture expected of velvet, blending somewhat into the matte gown fabric.
The fingers wrapping around the white rolled document appear slightly fused and lack clear definition between individual digits. The grip looks physically ambiguous.
The tassel attachment point and the board's geometry seem slightly warped relative to the head's angle, though this could be due to the low resolution.
